note: Adapted from the original description of Silvestri 1912 (Latin), published as Eutermellus convergens sp. n., the type species of the genus; the alate, soldier and worker are described, with measurements. The original uses the comma as decimal separator, transcribed here as 9.5, 5.8, 0.80 and so on.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate chestnut-coloured, the head blackish chestnut, the abdomen red chestnut, the wings pale smoky; soldier straw-coloured, the head pale ochreous white, the nasus brick red, antennae 13-segmented with segment 3 slightly longer than segment 4; pronotum with a well-developed anterior lobe, its anterior margin slightly concave in the middle. The species is the type species of the genus Eutermellus.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Alate: body chestnut-coloured, head blackish chestnut, abdomen red chestnut, wings pale smoky. Measurements: body length with wings 9.5 mm, without wings 5.8 mm; head length 0.80 mm, width 0.70 mm; long diameter of the eye 0.26 mm; antenna length 1.40 mm; forewing length 7.7 mm, width 2.2 mm; hind tibia length 1.10 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Soldier: body straw-coloured, head pale ochreous white, nasus brick red, abdomen straw-coloured through the gut contents. Head shape as figured; antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 4. Pronotum with a well-developed anterior lobe, its anterior margin slightly concave in the middle. Abdomen with rather many short hairs and a few considerably long ones. Measurements: body length 3.5 mm; head length (with the nasus) 1.37 mm; head width 0.65 mm; antenna length 1.30 mm; hind tibia length 0.68 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Worker: body straw-coloured, head milky white, abdomen grey through the gut contents. Head nearly circular, antennal segments 1—6 as figured. Pronotum with a well-developed anterior lobe, its anterior margin not or hardly concave in the middle. Abdomen with rather many short hairs. Measurements: body length 3.4 mm; head width 0.70 mm; antenna length 1.04 mm; hind tibia length 0.71 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Locality: Basilé, Fernando Pó Island, altitude 400—600 m, collected on the fifth day of the sixth month (5 June, month 6).
